note: 523264 allocations of 64 KiB and 1024 of 32 MiB at one call site. With the 32 byte string header, Zend MM reserves 69632 bytes (17 pages) and 33558528 bytes (4 KiB OS pages), so 523264 * 69632 + 1024 * 33558528 = 70799851520 reserved bytes in 524288 allocations. An allocation of size s has sampling probability p = 1 - exp(-s / L), where L is the sampling interval. Estimated totals are sums of 1/p for count and s/p for bytes over sampled allocations: in expectation, p * (1/p) = 1 and p * (s/p) = s. At L = 4 MiB, relative standard deviations are 1.07% for count and 0.55% for bytes; the 6% margins exceed five standard deviations. 16 KiB OS pages add less than 0.1%.
